Celosia spicata — Requested taxon account; retain regional, cultivation and toxicity qualifications.

Description: Wheat Celosia is a dense herbaceous annual with an upright spreading habit of growth in the Amaranth family.  Its multiple showy blooms reach up to 4 feet tall providing a long season of blooms They are great as a cut or dried flower also. They withstand the fall weather to provide structure in a winter garden.

Description: The foliage is dense to the ground and its narrow leaves remain green all season. It prefers rich soils in full sun and tolerates a variety of pHs and drought once established. It is intolerant of standing water.

Description: Wheat Celosia works well planted in mass, along borders or in containers as the center "thriller."

Description: VIDEO created by Andy Pulte for “Landscape Plant Identification, Taxonomy and Morphology” a plant identification course offered by the Department of Plant Sciences, University of Tennessee.
